h5-ban.ch: 这里的风景__画一般美丽。
h5-ban.en: The scenery here is as beautiful as a painting.
h5-ban.why: 像 opens the comparison; 一般 closes it: 像 + noun + 一般.

h5-ban.en: His smile is as warm as sunshine.
h5-ban.why: 像 + noun + 一般 + adjective: the thing compared sits between 像 and 一般.

h5-ban.ch: 她的声音音乐一般好听。
h5-ban.fix: 她的声音像音乐一般好听。
h5-ban.en: Her voice is as lovely as music.
h5-ban.why: Without 像 in front, 一般 reads as "ordinary" - put 像 before the noun.
Noun + 般的 + noun is the short written form: 梦般的日子.
般的 goes straight after the noun it compares to: 孩子般的脸.

h5-baokuo.en: This price includes coffee and cake.
h5-baokuo.why: 包括 names what a total covers.

h5-baokuo.ch: 包括老师__，一共有三十个人参加。
h5-baokuo.en: Thirty people took part, counting the teacher.
h5-baokuo.why: 包括 + person + 在内 counts that person in.

h5-baokuo.en: Does this price include the entrance ticket?
h5-baokuo.why: Whole + 包括 + part: the price comes first, then what it covers.

h5-baokuo.ch: 我们学校包括三千个学生。
h5-baokuo.fix: 我们学校有三千个学生。
h5-baokuo.en: Our school has three thousand students.
h5-baokuo.why: A plain head count takes 有; 包括 is for naming the parts.

h5-baokuo.en: Our whole family went, including my grandma.
h5-baokuo.why: 包括 comes right before the part being counted in.

h5-bian.ch: 他一看到妈妈，__哭了起来。
h5-bian.en: As soon as he saw his mum, he burst into tears.
h5-bian.why: 一 A，便 B: the written twin of 一……就.

h5-bian.en: As soon as she got home she started watching TV.
h5-bian.why: 便 sits right before the verb, after the 一 A part.

h5-bian.ch: 只要坚持下去，便能看到结果。
h5-bian.en: As long as you keep going, you'll see results.
h5-bian.why: 只要 A，便 B works just like 只要 A，就 B, in a written tone.

h5-bian.ch: （打电话）你到了机场便给我发个短信吧。
h5-bian.fix: （打电话）你到了机场就给我发个短信吧。
h5-bian.en: (On the phone) Text me when you get to the airport.
h5-bian.why: 便 is for writing; when you're talking, say 就.

h5-bian.en: They set off as soon as it got light.
h5-bian.why: 便 goes after the subject, right before the verb.

h5-bijing.ch: 别说他了，他__才来了一个星期。
h5-bijing.en: Go easy on him - he's only been here a week, after all.
h5-bijing.why: 毕竟 points to the basic fact that excuses him.

h5-bijing.en: Do you want to go or not? Just say!
h5-bijing.why: A question that pushes for an answer takes 到底, not 毕竟.

h5-bijing.en: Which one do you actually like?
h5-bijing.why: 毕竟 is for statements; a demanding question uses 到底.

h5-bijing.en: Don't be angry - she's only a child, after all.
h5-bijing.why: 毕竟 + (还) 是 + the basic fact that explains things.

h5-bijing.en: It's tiring, but after all, you chose it yourself.
h5-bijing.why: 毕竟 comes after 但是 and before the fact it points to.

h5-buru.ch: 天气太冷了，__我们在家看电影吧。
h5-buru.en: It's too cold - we might as well watch a film at home.
h5-buru.why: Before a verb, 不如 suggests the better plan.

h5-buru.en: My Chinese isn't as good as his.
h5-buru.why: No 很 or 非常 after 不如 + B - the plain adjective does the work.

h5-buru.ch: 我做的菜不如妈妈做的很好吃。
h5-buru.fix: 我做的菜不如妈妈做的好吃。
h5-buru.en: My cooking isn't as good as Mum's.
h5-buru.why: Drop 很: A 不如 B + plain adjective.

h5-buru.en: It's already eleven - we might as well go tomorrow.
h5-buru.why: 不如 comes first in the suggestion, before the better plan.
tpy: yǐ jīng shí yì diǎn le

h5-buru.en: This phone isn't as easy to use as that one.
h5-buru.why: A 不如 B + adjective: 不如 sits between the two things compared.

h5-cengjing.ch: 他__是我最好的朋友，可是现在我们不联系了。
h5-cengjing.en: He was once my best friend, but we're not in touch now.
h5-cengjing.why: 曾经 is a past that's over; 已经 would mean it's still true.

h5-cengjing.ch: 他曾经到公司了，你不用去接他。
h5-cengjing.fix: 他已经到公司了，你不用去接他。
h5-cengjing.en: He's already at the office - you don't need to pick him up.
h5-cengjing.why: "Already", with the result still true now, is 已经.

h5-cengjing.ch: 这家商店曾经很有名，现在已经没有人知道了。
h5-cengjing.en: This shop was once famous; now nobody knows it.
h5-cengjing.why: 曾经 marks the famous past; 已经 marks how things stand now.

h5-cengjing.en: He was a teacher once, when he was young.
h5-cengjing.why: 曾经 + verb + 过: 曾经 goes before the verb, 过 right after it.
tpy: tā nián qīng de shí hou

h5-cengjing.en: She was once the best student in our class.
h5-cengjing.why: 曾经 goes after the subject, before 是 or the verb.

h5-chao.ch: 我们的教室__南，所以冬天很暖和。
h5-chao.en: Our classroom faces south, so it's warm in winter.
h5-chao.why: On its own, 朝 + direction means "face".

h5-chao.en: I borrowed a book from him.
h5-chao.why: Borrowing from someone takes 向; 朝 is only about direction.
Learning from someone takes 向, not 朝.

h5-chao.en: She looked out of the door.
h5-chao.why: 朝 + place + verb: which way she looked.

h5-chao.en: The puppy came over to me.
h5-chao.why: 朝 + person comes before the verb to show the direction.

h5-chen.ch: 趁__年轻，多去几个国家看看。
h5-chen.en: Visit a few more countries while you're young.
h5-chen.why: 趁 can take 着: 趁着 + the good moment.

h5-chen.ch: 趁身体不舒服，他今天没有去上班。
h5-chen.fix: 因为身体不舒服，他今天没有去上班。
h5-chen.en: He didn't go to work today because he wasn't feeling well.
h5-chen.why: 趁 is for seizing a good moment, not giving a reason - use 因为.

h5-chen.ch: 趁周末有时间，我把房间打扫了一下。
h5-chen.en: I used the free time at the weekend to clean my room.
h5-chen.why: 趁 + the chance (free weekend) + what you do with it.

h5-chen.en: He wants to use the summer holiday to get a job.
h5-chen.why: 趁 + the moment comes before the action.

h5-chen.en: I want to use this chance to talk with him.
h5-chen.why: 趁 goes right before the chance you're using.

h5-chengdu.ch: 问题已经严重到了不能不解决的__。
h5-chengdu.en: The problem has become so serious it has to be dealt with.
h5-chengdu.why: 到了……的程度 says how far a state has gone.

h5-chengdu.ch: 他的汉语__很高，已经能当翻译了。
h5-chengdu.en: His Chinese is so good he can already work as an interpreter.
h5-chengdu.why: Skill level is 水平; 程度 is how far a state goes.

h5-chengdu.ch: 她累到了站都站不起来的水平。
h5-chengdu.fix: 她累到了站都站不起来的程度。
h5-chengdu.en: She was so tired she couldn't even stand up.
h5-chengdu.why: How far a state goes is 程度, not 水平.

h5-chengdu.en: He's recovered enough to go back to work.
h5-chengdu.why: 到了 + what it has led to + 的程度.
tpy: tā de shēn tǐ yǐ jīng

h5-chengdu.en: His success is largely down to his hard work.
h5-chengdu.why: 在很大程度上 = largely; 程度 sits between 很大 and 上.

h5-chizao.ch: 你总是不复习，考试__会出问题的。
h5-chizao.en: You never revise - sooner or later your exams will go wrong.
h5-chizao.why: 迟早 + 会 looks ahead to something bound to happen.

h5-chizao.ch: 他找了半年，__找到了工作。
h5-chizao.en: After six months of looking, he finally found a job.
h5-chizao.why: It has already happened, so 终于; 迟早 is for the future.

h5-chizao.en: I'll pass the exam sooner or later.
h5-chizao.why: 迟早 is about the future: pair it with 会, not a past 了.

h5-chizao.en: Don't worry - you'll get used to life here sooner or later.
h5-chizao.why: 迟早 comes before 会 + verb.

h5-chizao.en: If you eat lots of sugar every day, you'll put on weight sooner or later.
h5-chizao.why: 迟早 goes right before 会.

h5-chufei.ch: 除非你亲自去跟他谈，__他不会同意的。
h5-chufei.en: He won't agree unless you go and talk to him yourself.
h5-chufei.why: 除非 + condition，否则 + what happens if it isn't met.

h5-chufei.en: I'm not leaving unless you tell me why.
h5-chufei.why: 否则 opens the second half, then the result.
tpy: chú fēi nǐ gào su wǒ yuán yīn

h5-chufei.ch: 除非老板同意，我们也可以休息。
h5-chufei.fix: 除非老板同意，我们才可以休息。
h5-chufei.en: We can only take a break if the boss agrees.
h5-chufei.why: The second half needs 才 (or 否则 / 不然), not 也.

h5-chufei.ch: 我不会原谅他的，除非他向我道歉。
h5-chufei.en: I won't forgive him unless he apologises to me.
h5-chufei.why: In speech the 除非 half can come last: result first, then 除非 + condition.

h5-chufei.en: We won't give up unless they change their minds.
h5-chufei.why: 除非 goes right before the one condition that would change things.

h5-congci.ch: 那年他搬走了，__我们就再也没有联系过。
h5-congci.en: He moved away that year, and we've never been in touch since.
h5-congci.why: 从此 starts from the event just told: from then on.

h5-congci.en: I've never been to that place.
h5-congci.why: "Never (ever)" covers all time: 从来. 从此 needs a turning point.

h5-congci.ch: 他从此没有迟到过，是个好学生。
h5-congci.fix: 他从来没有迟到过，是个好学生。
h5-congci.en: He's never been late - he's a good student.
h5-congci.why: With no turning point, "never" is 从来, not 从此.

h5-congci.en: He went to China once and has loved Chinese food ever since.
h5-congci.why: Turning point first, then 从此 + the new state.
tpy: tā qù le yí cì Zhōng guó

h5-congci.en: After the teacher told him off that day, he was never late again.
h5-congci.why: 从此 comes before the lasting change, ahead of 再也.

h5-congrer.ch: 路上堵车，__我上课迟到了。
h5-congrer.en: The traffic was bad, so I was late for class.
h5-congrer.why: A plain cause and result takes 所以; 从而 is for a method and what it achieves, in writing.

h5-congrer.ch: 学校延长了图书馆的开放时间，__方便了学生。
h5-congrer.en: The school extended the library's opening hours, making things easier for students.
h5-congrer.why: Step first, then 从而 + the result it brings.

h5-congrer.ch: 他感冒了，从而没有来上课。
h5-congrer.fix: 他感冒了，所以没有来上课。
h5-congrer.en: He had a cold, so he didn't come to class.
h5-congrer.why: Catching a cold isn't a method - use 所以 for a plain cause.

tiles: 他们减少了开会的时间，
h5-congrer.en: They cut down meeting time and so worked more efficiently.
h5-congrer.why: Method, then 从而 + the result it led to.
tpy: tā men jiǎn shǎo le kāi huì de shí jiān

h5-congrer.en: The city gained many parks, which made people's lives healthier.
h5-congrer.why: 从而 opens the second half, before the result.

h5-de-buxing.ch: 今天走了一天的路，我的脚疼__不行。
h5-de-buxing.en: I've been walking all day - my feet are killing me.
I'm starving - is there anything to eat?
h5-de-buxing.why: After 得, 不行 finishes the pattern; 非常 / 太 can't stand there alone.

h5-de-buxing.ch: 这几天我非常忙得不行。
h5-de-buxing.en: I've been incredibly busy these past few days.
h5-de-buxing.why: 得不行 already means "extremely" - drop 非常.

h5-de-buxing.en: I worked till three last night - I'm dead tired.
tpy: zuó tiān wǎn shang gōng zuò dào sān diǎn

h5-de-buxing.en: This room is unbearably hot - let's change rooms.
h5-de-buxing.why: 不行 comes after 得 to push the feeling to the top.

h5-ding.fix: 这件衣服比那件贵多了。
h5-ding.en: This piece of clothing is much more expensive than that one.
h5-ding.why: 顶 means "most", so like 最 it can't go in a 比 sentence.

h5-ding.ch: 这几个菜里，我顶喜欢这个。
h5-ding.en: Of these dishes, this is the one I like best.
h5-ding.why: 顶 + 喜欢 works like 最喜欢, in a casual tone.

h5-ding.en: This is my very favourite book.
h5-ding.why: 顶 goes right before the adjective or feeling verb.

h5-ding.en: This restaurant's noodles are the best.
h5-ding.why: 顶 goes right before the adjective, like 最.

h5-dique.ch: 你说得对，这个办法__不错。
h5-dique.en: You're right - this method really is good.
h5-dique.why: 的确 confirms something is true, often agreeing with someone.

h5-dique.ch: 我喝过了，这里的咖啡__很好喝。
h5-dique.en: I've tried it - the coffee here really is good.
h5-dique.why: 的确 goes in a statement to say "yes, it really is so".
的确 confirms a statement; a question that pushes for an answer uses 到底.

h5-dique.en: What he said really is right.
h5-dique.why: 的确 goes before the verb; here 的 is dí.

h5-dique.en: These clothes are a bit pricey, it's true, but the quality is good.
h5-dique.why: 的确 goes after the subject, before the description.

h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.ch: 别__不起他，他其实很有能力。
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.en: Don't look down on him - he's actually very capable.

h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.ch: 这个包太贵了，我不能买起。
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.fix: 这个包太贵了，我买不起。
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.en: This bag is too expensive - I can't afford it.
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.why: Put 不 between the verb and 起.

h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.ch: 现在工资高了，我也住得起好一点儿的宾馆了。
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.en: Now that I earn more, I can afford a nicer hotel too.
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.why: Verb + 得起 says you can afford it.

h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.en: I still can't afford a new phone.
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.why: Verb + 不起 + object: 买不起新手机.

h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.en: Ordinary people simply can't afford this kind of watch.
h5-dongci-de-bu-qi.why: 起 comes right after 买不.

h5-dongci-guo.ch: 他每天都练习，我比不__他。
h5-dongci-guo.en: He practises every day - I can't beat him.
h5-dongci-guo.why: Verb + 不过 + person: can't beat someone at it.

h5-dongci-guo.ch: 他从我们教室前面走__，没有进来。
h5-dongci-guo.en: He walked past our classroom but didn't come in.
h5-dongci-guo.why: Verb + 过 can mean moving past something.
To say you can't beat someone, put 不 between the verb and 过.

h5-dongci-guo.ch: 把鱼翻过来再做两分钟。
h5-dongci-guo.en: Turn the fish over and cook it two more minutes.
h5-dongci-guo.why: 翻过来 is 过 as "turning over".

h5-dongci-guo.en: Once we cross that bridge, we're there.
h5-dongci-guo.why: 过 goes right after the verb: 走过 = walk across.

h5-dongci-kai.en: He opened his eyes and checked his phone.
h5-dongci-kai.why: Eyes take 睁开; 推开 and 拉开 are for doors.

h5-dongci-kai.en: Push the window open a bit.
h5-dongci-kai.why: 开 is the result, so it comes after the verb: 推开.

h5-dongci-kai.en: Don't be sad - try to let it go.
h5-dongci-kai.why: 想开 is 开 in the mind: stop dwelling on it.

h5-dongci-kai.en: The two of them have never been apart.
h5-dongci-kai.why: 分开 = move apart; 过 follows the whole verb.

h5-dongci-kai.en: He pushed the door open and came in.
h5-dongci-kai.why: 开 goes right after the verb: 推开门.

h5-dongci-xialai.why: 写下来: 下来 means the thing gets kept.

h5-dongci-xialai.ch: 听到这个消息，他过了很久才冷静__。
h5-dongci-xialai.en: After hearing the news, it took him a long time to calm down.
h5-dongci-xialai.why: Settling into calm is 下来.

h5-dongci-xialai.ch: 音乐停了，房间里马上安静起来了。
h5-dongci-xialai.fix: 音乐停了，房间里马上安静下来了。
h5-dongci-xialai.en: The music stopped and the room went quiet at once.
h5-dongci-xialai.why: Settling into quiet is 下来; 起来 is for things picking up.
把 + thing + verb + 下来: keep it fixed.

h5-dongci-xialai.en: When the music started, the children went quiet at once and listened.
h5-dongci-xialai.why: 下来 comes after the state word: 安静了下来.

h5-dui.en: There's a pile of dirty clothes on the chair.
h5-dui.why: Things heaped together are counted with 堆.

h5-dui.en: There's some water on the floor - careful!
h5-dui.why: 堆 is for things you can heap up, not liquids.

h5-dui.ch: 他从中国回来，带了一大堆礼物。
h5-dui.en: He came back from China with loads of presents.
h5-dui.why: 一大堆 is a lively way to say "a whole lot of".

h5-dui.en: There's a big pile of old newspapers by the door.
h5-dui.why: 一 (大) 堆 + noun: the measure word comes before the thing.

h5-dui.en: He piled all his old clothes outside the door.
h5-dui.why: As a verb, 堆 goes before 在 + place.

h5-duokui.en: Good thing you reminded me, or I'd have been late.
h5-duokui.why: 多亏 + helper, then 不然 + what it saved you from.

h5-duokui.en: The match was called off because of the rain.
h5-duokui.why: A bad outcome needs 因为; 多亏 is only for help that saved you.

h5-duokui.ch: 多亏堵车，我们迟到了一个小时。
h5-duokui.fix: 因为堵车，我们迟到了一个小时。
h5-duokui.en: We arrived an hour late because of the traffic.
h5-duokui.why: Traffic didn't help you - a bad cause takes 因为.

h5-duokui.ch: 这次比赛能赢，多亏了大家的努力。
h5-duokui.en: We won this match thanks to everyone's hard work.
h5-duokui.why: 多亏了 + the help that made the good result possible.

h5-duokui.en: I owe it to that driver that I got my wallet back.
h5-duokui.why: 多亏 (了) comes right before the person you're thanking.

h5-fan-er.en: I wanted to help him, but he got angry instead.
h5-fan-er.why: 反而 flips what you'd expect: help should please him.

h5-fan-er.ch: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，__很便宜。
h5-fan-er.en: This restaurant's food is tasty, and cheap too.
h5-fan-er.why: Adding a second good point takes 而且, not 反而.

h5-fan-er.ch: 他每天都锻炼，反而更健康了。
h5-fan-er.fix: 他每天都锻炼，所以更健康了。
h5-fan-er.en: He exercises every day, so he's healthier.
h5-fan-er.why: Getting healthier is what you'd expect - no flip, so no 反而.

h5-fan-er.en: After two days' rest, he's actually more tired.
h5-fan-er.why: 反而 goes after the subject, before the unexpected result.

h5-fan-er.en: The roads were so jammed that the taxi was actually slower than walking.
h5-fan-er.why: 反而 comes after the subject (坐出租车), before the surprising result.

h5-fanzheng.ch: 别着急，__还有两个小时呢。
h5-fanzheng.en: No rush - we've got two hours anyway.
h5-fanzheng.why: 反正 gives a relaxed reason: the time is there whatever happens.

h5-fanzheng.ch: 我帮助了他，他__不高兴了。
h5-fanzheng.en: I helped him, and he got upset instead.
h5-fanzheng.why: An unexpected opposite result is 反而, not 反正.

h5-fanzheng.ch: 不管你同意不同意，反而我要去。
h5-fanzheng.fix: 不管你同意不同意，反正我要去。
h5-fanzheng.en: Whether you agree or not, I'm going anyway.
h5-fanzheng.why: "Whatever happens" is 反正; 反而 is an unexpected flip.

h5-fanzheng.ch: 你想吃什么就点什么吧，反正今天我请你。
h5-fanzheng.en: Order whatever you like - it's my treat today anyway.
h5-fanzheng.why: 反正 gives the fixed fact that makes the choice easy.

h5-fanzheng.en: Whatever other people say, I don't believe it.
h5-fanzheng.why: 不管……，反正 + the fixed decision.

h5-fei.ch: 这个会很重要，你非参加__。
h5-fei.en: This meeting is important - you really must attend.
h5-fei.why: 非 + verb + 不可: it won't do unless you do it.

h5-fei.ch: 明天的考试很重要，我非去。

h5-like.fix: 我下个月马上就要结婚了。
h5-like.why: A month away isn't "this very moment"; use 马上.

h5-like.en: The doctor said he must be taken to hospital at once.
h5-like.why: 立刻 goes right before the action.

h5-like.en: Seeing someone needed help, he went over right away.
h5-like.why: 立刻 goes after the subject, before the verb.
ppy: kàn dào yǒu rén xū yào bāng zhù

h5-lin.en: Remember to turn off the light as you leave.
h5-lin.why: 临 + verb = just as you are about to do it.

h5-lin.en: He only started revising just before the exam.
h5-lin.why: 临 points to the moment right before the exam.

h5-lin.ch: 临睡觉的时候，她总是要看一会儿书。
h5-lin.en: She always reads for a while just before bed.
h5-lin.why: 临 + 睡觉 + 的时候: right before going to sleep.

h5-lin.en: Just as I was going out, Mum gave me another apple.
h5-lin.why: 临 + verb + 的时候 opens the sentence.

h5-lin.en: Just before he left, he left the keys with me.
h5-lin.why: 临 goes right before the verb it marks.

h5-miqie.en: My home is close to the school.
h5-miqie.why: Short distance is 近; 密切 is about close ties.

h5-miqie.ch: 这两个国家的关系非常__。
h5-miqie.en: These two countries have very close relations.
h5-miqie.why: Close links between people or countries take 密切.

h5-miqie.en: Our two families live very close to each other.
h5-miqie.why: 密切 is about ties, not distance.

h5-miqie.en: We've always kept in close touch.
The manager told us to keep a close eye on the weather.
h5-miqie.why: As an adverb, 密切 goes before 注意.

h5-mou.en: A certain guest left their phone here.
h5-mou.why: 某 points to one specific person without naming them.

h5-mou.en: I want to go and buy some things.
h5-mou.why: A vague "some" is 一些; 某 is one particular, unnamed thing.

h5-mou.en: I feel like some fruit today.
h5-mou.why: For a vague "some", use 点儿 / 一些; 某 is one specific thing.

h5-mou.ch: 我们公司的某位经理下个月要离开了。
h5-mou.en: A certain manager at our company is leaving next month.
h5-mou.why: 某 + measure word + noun: a specific person you choose not to name.

h5-mou.en: I read this news in some magazine.
h5-mou.why: 某 comes before the measure word: 某本杂志.

h5-ng.ch: A：明天早上八点，好吗？B：__，好的。
h5-ng.en: A: Eight tomorrow morning, OK? B: Mm-hm, fine.
Huh? What did you say? Say it again.
h5-ng.why: A rising-tone 嗯 asks "huh? what was that?".

h5-ng.en: A: Have you eaten? B: Mm, I have.
h5-ng.why: Falling-tone 嗯 agrees or says yes.

h5-ng.ch: （作文）嗯，我认为保护环境很重要。
h5-ng.fix: （作文）我认为保护环境很重要。
h5-ng.en: (Essay) I think protecting the environment matters.
h5-ng.why: 嗯 is purely spoken - it's out of place in an essay.

h5-ng.en: A: Are you there yet? B: Mm, I'm here.
h5-ng.why: 嗯 opens the reply, before the comma.

h5-nanguai.ch: 他昨天晚上两点才睡觉，__今天看起来很累。
h5-nanguai.en: He didn't go to bed till two last night - no wonder he looks so tired today.
h5-nanguai.why: 难怪 goes before the result that now makes sense; the reason came first.

h5-nanguai.en: So he's changed jobs - no wonder he hasn't been in the office.
h5-nanguai.why: 原来 gives the reason; 难怪 + result follows.
tpy: yuán lái tā huàn gōng zuò le

h5-nanguai.ch: 难怪你的汉语说得很流利，原来你在北京住过五年。
h5-nanguai.en: No wonder your Chinese is so fluent - you lived in Beijing for five years.
h5-nanguai.why: 难怪 + result, then 原来 + reason: both halves are in the right place.

h5-nanguai.ch: 难怪他感冒了，他今天没有来上课。
h5-nanguai.fix: 他感冒了，难怪今天没有来上课。
h5-nanguai.en: He has a cold - no wonder he didn't come to class today.
h5-nanguai.why: 难怪 goes before the result (not coming), not before the reason (the cold).

h5-nanguai.en: So it's his birthday today - no wonder everyone's here.
h5-nanguai.why: 难怪 opens the result that now makes sense: 难怪大家都来了.

h5-nanmian.ch: 第一次参加比赛，__会有点儿紧张。
h5-nanmian.en: It's your first competition - you're bound to be a bit nervous.
h5-nanmian.why: 难免 = hard to avoid, so it's understandable; 避免 means to avoid something.

h5-nanmian.en: When work gets really busy, mistakes are only to be expected.
h5-nanmian.why: ……是难免的 closes the sentence: the thing that's hard to avoid comes first.

h5-nanmian.ch: 你提前出发，就可以难免堵车。
h5-nanmian.fix: 你提前出发，就可以避免堵车。
h5-nanmian.en: Set off early and you can avoid the traffic.
h5-nanmian.why: 'To avoid' is 避免; 难免 means something is bound to happen.

h5-nanmian.ch: 他刚来公司，对很多事情不熟悉，难免会问很多问题。
h5-nanmian.en: He's new at the company and doesn't know much yet, so he's bound to ask lots of questions.
h5-nanmian.why: 难免会 + verb excuses something that's only natural.

h5-nanmian.en: When two people live together, they're bound to argue sometimes.
h5-nanmian.why: 难免 sits right before 会 + verb.

h5-ningke.ch: 我宁可饿着，__不吃那家饭店的菜。
h5-ningke.en: I'd rather go hungry than eat that restaurant's food.
h5-ningke.why: 宁可 A 也不 B: the second half always uses 也.

h5-ningke.ch: 我宁可多花点儿钱，也要买质量好的。
h5-ningke.en: I'd rather spend a bit more and get good quality.
h5-ningke.why: 宁可 A 也要 B: you'll put up with A to get B.

h5-ningke.en: She'd rather buy fewer clothes so she can buy books for her child.
h5-ningke.why: 宁可 + what you put up with, then 也要 + the goal.
tpy: shǎo mǎi jǐ jiàn yī fu

h5-ningke.ch: 我宁可不睡觉，但是要把这本书看完。
h5-ningke.fix: 我宁可不睡觉，也要把这本书看完。
h5-ningke.en: I'd rather skip sleep and finish this book.
h5-ningke.why: 宁可 pairs with 也, not 但是.

h5-ningke.en: I'd rather stand than sit on that dirty chair.
h5-ningke.why: 宁可 comes after the subject, before the option you choose.

h5-ouran.ch: 我在一次聚会上__认识了他，后来我们成为了好朋友。
h5-ouran.en: I met him by chance at a party, and we became good friends.
h5-ouran.why: 偶然 = by chance; 偶尔 is 'now and then', about how often.

h5-ouran.en: The two of us met by chance on a plane.
h5-ouran.why: 偶然 goes right before the verb it describes: 偶然认识.

h5-ouran.ch: 这次比赛他得了冠军，这不是偶然的。
h5-ouran.en: He won this competition - that was no accident.
h5-ouran.why: 是偶然的 uses 偶然 as an adjective: by chance.

h5-ouran.ch: 他很少做菜，只是周末偶然做一次。
h5-ouran.fix: 他很少做菜，只是周末偶尔做一次。
h5-ouran.en: He rarely cooks - only once in a while at weekends.
h5-ouran.why: 'Once in a while' is about how often, so it's 偶尔, not 偶然.

h5-ouran.en: In the park I happened to run into my old teacher.
h5-ouran.why: 偶然 goes before the verb: 我偶然遇到了.

h5-pian.ch: 我吃了两__药，现在好多了。
h5-pian.en: I took two tablets and I feel much better now.
h5-pian.why: Thin flat things like tablets are counted with 片.
A map is paper, so it takes 张; 片 is for thin slices.

h5-pian.en: Behind the school there's a big stretch of grass.
h5-pian.why: 一大片 + noun describes a wide area you see at a glance.

h5-pian.en: It's dark now, and all around is quiet.
h5-pian.why: 一片 + 安静 sums up a whole scene or mood.
片 sits between the number and the noun: 两片面包.

h5-ping.ch: __这张票，你可以免费参观博物馆。
h5-ping.en: With this ticket you can visit the museum for free.
h5-ping.why: 凭 + ticket or proof: that's what lets you do it.

h5-ping.ch: 凭医生的意见，他需要在家休息一个月。
h5-ping.fix: 根据医生的意见，他需要在家休息一个月。
h5-ping.en: According to the doctor, he needs a month's rest at home.
h5-ping.why: For what a source says, use 根据; 凭 backs up your own action or claim.

h5-ping.en: She became a star through her own hard work.
h5-ping.why: 凭 + what you rely on comes before the verb.

h5-ping.ch: 你凭什么让我走？这是我的座位。
h5-ping.en: What gives you the right to tell me to leave? This is my seat.
h5-ping.why: 凭什么 is a sharp 'what gives you the right?'.

h5-ping.en: With these grades he can apply to very good schools.
h5-ping.why: 凭 + what backs him up comes after the subject and before the verb.

h5-pingchang.ch: 丢一次钥匙是很__的事情，别着急。
h5-pingchang.en: Losing your keys once is perfectly normal - don't worry.
h5-pingchang.why: Only 平常 can be an adjective meaning 'ordinary'; 平时 just means 'usually'.

h5-pingchang.en: He doesn't usually drink much beer, but today he drank a lot.
h5-pingchang.why: 平常 sets up the usual pattern; 今天却 gives today's exception.

h5-pingchang.ch: 这是一个很平时的周末。
h5-pingchang.fix: 这是一个很平常的周末。
h5-pingchang.en: It was a very ordinary weekend.
h5-pingchang.why: 平时 only means 'usually'; for 'ordinary' use 平常.

h5-pingchang.ch: 我平常坐地铁上班，今天下雨就坐出租车了。
h5-pingchang.en: I usually take the metro to work, but it rained today so I took a taxi.
h5-pingchang.why: 平常 = on usual days, contrasted with today.

h5-pingchang.en: For him, this kind of thing is nothing unusual.
h5-pingchang.why: As an adjective, 平常 follows 很: 很平常.

h5-qi.ch: 从下星期__，图书馆晚上十点关门。
h5-qi.en: From next week on, the library closes at ten at night.
h5-qi.why: 从 + time + 起 = from then on; 以来 only looks back to now.

h5-qi.en: Whenever Grandma talks about when she was young, she gets really happy.
h5-qi.why: 说起 + topic brings it into the conversation.
tpy: nián qīng shí hou de shì qing

h5-qi.ch: 下个月从起，我每天学习一个小时汉语。
h5-qi.fix: 从下个月起，我每天学习一个小时汉语。
h5-qi.en: From next month on, I'll study Chinese for an hour every day.
h5-qi.why: The time goes between 从 and 起: 从下个月起.

h5-qi.ch: 看到这张照片，我想起了很多以前的事情。
h5-qi.en: Seeing this photo, I remembered lots of things from the past.
h5-qi.why: 想起 + thing: it comes back into your mind.

h5-qi.en: From next month on, our pay is going up.
h5-qi.why: 起 closes the time phrase: 从下个月起.

h5-qingyi.ch: 这次考试很__，大家都及格了。
h5-qingyi.en: This exam was easy - everyone passed.
h5-qingyi.why: 'Easy' after 很 is the adjective 容易; 轻易 is an adverb.
轻易 goes after the negative and before the verb: 不轻易说.

h5-qingyi.ch: 他不会轻易放弃的，你放心吧。
h5-qingyi.en: He won't give up that easily - don't worry.
h5-qingyi.why: 不会 + 轻易 + verb: he won't do it too readily.

h5-qingyi.ch: 这个题很轻易，我一分钟就做完了。
h5-qingyi.fix: 这个题很容易，我一分钟就做完了。
h5-qingyi.en: This question is easy - I finished it in a minute.
h5-qingyi.why: 'Easy' is 容易; 轻易 describes acting too readily.

h5-qingyi.en: You're still young - don't talk about giving up so lightly.
h5-qingyi.why: 轻易 comes right after 别: 别轻易 + verb.

h5-qiyu.ch: 这个班我只认识班长，__的同学都不认识。
h5-qiyu.en: In this class I only know the class monitor - I don't know any of the others.
h5-qiyu.why: 其余 = the rest of the group you just mentioned.

h5-qiyu.ch: 你还有其余的事情吗？没有我就走了。
h5-qiyu.fix: 你还有其他的事情吗？没有我就走了。
h5-qiyu.en: Is there anything else? If not, I'll go.
h5-qiyu.why: With no fixed group being divided, 'anything else' is 其他.

h5-qiyu.en: Of these books I've only read three; I haven't read the rest yet.
h5-qiyu.why: Name one part first, then 其余的 for what's left.

h5-qiyu.ch: 除了经理，其余的同事都同意这个计划。
h5-qiyu.en: Apart from the manager, all the other colleagues agree with the plan.
h5-qiyu.why: 其余 looks back at the whole team minus the manager.

h5-qiyu.en: There are five of us: two are taking a taxi and the rest the metro.
h5-qiyu.why: 其余的 = the remaining three of the five.

liǎng ge zuò chū zū chē

h5-ruhe.ch: 明天下午去参观博物馆，大家觉得__？
h5-ruhe.en: How about visiting the museum tomorrow afternoon?
h5-ruhe.why: At the end of a question, 如何 means 怎么样; 怎么 can't end a sentence like this.

h5-ruhe.en: Today's meeting is mainly about how to work more efficiently.
h5-ruhe.why: 如何 + two-syllable verb: 如何提高.

h5-ruhe.ch: 这本书主要讲如何安排自己的时间。
h5-ruhe.en: This book is mainly about how to organise your time.
h5-ruhe.why: 如何 + two-syllable verb: the formal 'how to'.

h5-ruhe.ch: 这篇文章告诉我们保护如何环境。
h5-ruhe.fix: 这篇文章告诉我们如何保护环境。
h5-ruhe.en: This article tells us how to protect the environment.
h5-ruhe.why: 如何 goes before the verb, not between the verb and its object.

h5-ruhe.en: This programme is about how to choose a job that suits you.
h5-ruhe.why: 如何 goes right before the two-syllable verb: 如何选择.

h5-shebude.ch: 这个杯子是朋友送的，我一直__用。
h5-shebude.en: A friend gave me this cup, so I've never been able to bring myself to use it.
h5-shebude.why: 舍不得 + verb: you can't bear to use it.

h5-shebude.en: This puppy is so cute - I really can't bear to give it away.
h5-shebude.why: 舍不得 goes right before the verb you can't bear to do.
tpy: zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu hěn kě ài

h5-shebude.ch: 我舍不得游泳，我从来没有练习过。
h5-shebude.fix: 我不会游泳，我从来没有练习过。
h5-shebude.en: I can't swim - I've never practised.
h5-shebude.why: 舍不得 is an emotional 'can't bear to'; a missing skill is 不会.

h5-shebude.ch: 妈妈舍不得扔旧东西，家里的东西越来越多。
h5-shebude.en: Mum can't bear to throw old things away, so the house keeps filling up.
h5-shebude.why: 舍不得扔: it hurts her to part with them.

h5-shebude.en: If you can't bear to leave, stay a few more days.
h5-shebude.why: 舍不得 comes right before the verb 走.

h5-shide.ch: 她好像很累__，一回家就躺下了。
h5-shide.en: She seemed really tired - she lay down as soon as she got home.
h5-shide.why: 好像……似的 = as if; 似的 closes the comparison.

h5-shide.ch: 他饿得像三天没有吃东西一样似的。
h5-shide.fix: 他饿得像三天没有吃东西似的。
h5-shide.en: He was so hungry it was as if he hadn't eaten for three days.
h5-shide.why: 似的 already does the job of 一样 - use one, not both.

h5-shide.en: The room is so clean it looks brand new.
h5-shide.why: 像 + comparison + 似的: 似的 closes the comparison.

h5-shide.ch: 他说话的样子，好像他是老板似的。
h5-shide.en: The way he talks, you'd think he was the boss.
It's as dark as night, but it's only three in the afternoon.
h5-shide.why: 似的 closes the comparison right after 像晚上.

h5-shike.ch: 你什么__有空？我们一起去喝咖啡吧。
h5-shike.en: When are you free? Let's go for a coffee.
h5-shike.why: Everyday 'when' is 什么时候; 时刻 is for special moments.

h5-shike.en: The moment my child was born, I cried with joy.

h5-shike.ch: 带孩子出门，要时刻看好他。
h5-shike.en: When you take a child out, keep an eye on them every moment.
h5-shike.why: Before a verb, 时刻 means 'at every moment'.

h5-shike.ch: 我们明天什么时刻出发？
h5-shike.fix: 我们明天什么时候出发？
h5-shike.en: What time are we setting off tomorrow?
h5-shike.why: An everyday 'when' question uses 时候, not the weighty 时刻.

h5-shike.en: Mum works in another city, but she thinks of her children at home all the time.
h5-shike.why: As an adverb, 时刻 goes right before the verb: 时刻想着.

h5-shu.ch: 我们班__他汉语说得最流利。
h5-shu.en: He speaks Chinese the most fluently in our class.
h5-shu.why: Group + 数 + person + 最: count through the group and he comes out top.

h5-shu.ch: 这几家饭店里，数这家很便宜。
h5-shu.fix: 这几家饭店里，数这家最便宜。
h5-shu.en: Of these restaurants, this one is the cheapest.
h5-shu.why: 数 picks out the top one, so it needs 最, not 很.

h5-shu.en: Of these cities, Beijing is the liveliest.
h5-shu.why: 数 + the one that stands out + 最 + adjective.

h5-shu.ch: 我们家数奶奶身体最好。
h5-shu.en: In our family, Grandma is the healthiest.
h5-shu.why: Group + 数 + person + 最: 数奶奶身体最好.

h5-shu.en: He's the oldest person in our company.
h5-shu.why: 数 comes right before the person who stands out.

h5-shuobuding.ch: 别着急，你的钥匙__在办公室里。
h5-shuobuding.en: Don't panic - your keys might be in the office.
h5-shuobuding.why: 说不定 = maybe, it could well be so.

h5-shuobuding.en: Whether I'll still be at this company next month isn't settled yet.
h5-shuobuding.why: At the end of a sentence, 还说不定 means 'it's not settled yet'.

h5-shuobuding.ch: 长得好看的人说不定性格好。
h5-shuobuding.fix: 长得好看的人不一定性格好。
h5-shuobuding.en: Good-looking people don't necessarily have nice personalities.
h5-shuobuding.why: 'Not necessarily' is 不一定; 说不定 means 'it may well be'.

h5-shuobuding.ch: 多买点儿菜吧，说不定晚上有朋友来。
h5-shuobuding.en: Buy a bit more food - some friends might drop by tonight.
h5-shuobuding.why: 说不定 raises something that could well happen.

h5-shuobuding.en: Go and have a look - there might still be tickets.
h5-shuobuding.why: 说不定 opens the guess: 说不定还有票.

h5-suan.ch: 这个房间有三十平方米，不__小。
h5-suan.en: This room is thirty square metres - that's not small.
h5-suan.why: 不算 + adjective: it doesn't count as small.

h5-suan.en: When are you planning to come back?
h5-suan.why: 'Plan to' is 打算; 算 alone means 'count as'.

h5-suan.en: This exam wasn't really hard - most people passed.
h5-suan.why: 不算 + adjective softens the judgement.

h5-suan.ch: 算了，这件事情我们明天再说吧。
h5-suan.en: Forget it - let's talk about it tomorrow.
h5-suan.why: 算了 is the everyday 'never mind, forget it'.

h5-suan.en: Ten people ate for 500 kuai - that's not really a lot.

h5-suo.en: That's all I know about the situation.
h5-suo.why: Doer + 所 + verb + 的: what I know.
所 comes after the doer, right before the verb.

h5-suo.en: This is exactly what we need.
h5-suo.why: 所 sits between the doer and the verb: 我们所需要的.

h5-suo.ch: 你所担心的事情，并没有发生。
h5-suo.en: What you were worried about didn't happen after all.
h5-suo.why: Doer 你 + 所 + 担心 + 的 + noun.

h5-suo.en: We'll think carefully about every suggestion you've all made.
h5-suo.why: 所 goes right after the doer and before the verb: 大家所提出的.

h5-suowei.ch: __好朋友，就是能一起哭也能一起笑的人。
h5-suowei.en: A good friend is someone you can cry and laugh with.
h5-suowei.why: 所谓 X，就是 Y introduces a term to explain it.

h5-suowei.ch: 我有个所谓李月的同学，她在银行工作。
h5-suowei.fix: 我有个叫李月的同学，她在银行工作。
h5-suowei.en: I have a classmate called Li Yue who works in a bank.
h5-suowei.why: To give someone's name, use 叫; 所谓 explains a term or sounds sceptical.

h5-suowei.en: His so-called 'new computer' has actually been in use for three years.
h5-suowei.why: 所谓的 + noun doubts the label, like 'so-called'.

h5-suowei.ch: 所谓健康，不只是身体好，心情也要好。
h5-suowei.en: Being healthy isn't just about your body - your mood matters too.
h5-suowei.why: 所谓 + term, then the explanation.

h5-suowei.en: So this is what they call 'China speed'.
h5-suowei.why: 所谓的 + term: 就是所谓的…….

h5-ti.ch: 你去超市的时候，能不能__我买点儿牛奶？
h5-ti.en: When you go to the supermarket, could you buy some milk for me?
h5-ti.why: 替 + person + verb: you do it for them.

h5-ti.ch: 我明天有事情，你能上班替我吗？
h5-ti.fix: 我明天有事情，你能替我上班吗？
h5-ti.en: I've got something on tomorrow - could you work my shift?
h5-ti.why: 替 + person goes before the verb, not at the end like English 'for me'.

h5-ti.en: Don't worry about me - I'll be fine on my own.
h5-ti.why: 替 + person + 担心: worried on someone's behalf.

h5-ti.ch: 今天我替他去机场接客人。
h5-ti.en: Today I'm going to the airport to pick up the guests in his place.
h5-ti.why: 替 + person + verb: doing it in his place.

h5-ti.en: I can't speak Chinese - could you ask for me?
h5-ti.why: 替 + person comes before the verb: 替我问问.

h5-wanyi.ch: 出门多带件衣服吧，__晚上冷呢？
h5-wanyi.en: Take an extra layer when you go out - what if it gets cold tonight?
h5-wanyi.why: 万一……呢？ raises an unlikely but unwelcome possibility.

h5-wanyi.ch: 万一你通过了考试，我就送你一台电脑。
h5-wanyi.fix: 如果你通过了考试，我就送你一台电脑。
h5-wanyi.en: If you pass the exam, I'll give you a computer.
h5-wanyi.why: Passing is good news, so use 如果; 万一 is only for things you'd rather not happen.

h5-wanyi.en: Write down my number - just in case something comes up.
h5-wanyi.why: The advice comes first; 万一 + unwelcome event follows as an afterthought.

h5-wanyi.ch: 多带点儿水，万一路上买不到呢？
h5-wanyi.en: Take some extra water - what if you can't buy any on the way?
Buy a spare - what if it breaks?
h5-wanyi.why: 万一 goes right before the unwelcome event: 万一坏了呢？

h5-wei.ch: 我们把这篇文章分__三个部分。
h5-wei.en: We split this article into three parts.
h5-wei.why: 分为 = divide into; 为 (wéi) sits right after the verb 分.

h5-wei.en: The students in our class were split into four groups.
h5-wei.why: 分为 + result: into four groups.
tpy: wǒ men bān de xué sheng

h5-wei.ch: 人们也称长城为“万里长城”。
h5-wei.en: People also call the Great Wall the 'Ten-Thousand-Li Great Wall'.
h5-wei.why: 称 A 为 B = call A B.

h5-wei.en: This book is divided into three parts.
h5-wei.why: 为 goes right after the verb: 分为, not 为分.

h5-wei.en: The competition is split into two parts, morning and afternoon.
h5-wei.why: 为 goes right after the one-syllable verb: 分为.

h5-wei-suo.ch: 这个地方为很多年轻人__喜欢。
h5-wei-suo.en: This place is popular with lots of young people.
h5-wei-suo.why: 为 + doer + 所 + verb: 所 sits right before the verb.

h5-wei-suo.en: We were all moved by his story.
h5-wei-suo.why: A + 为 + doer + 所 + verb: the written passive.

h5-wei-suo.ch: 这种看法已经为所很多人接受。
h5-wei-suo.fix: 这种看法已经为很多人所接受。
h5-wei-suo.en: This view has now been accepted by lots of people.
h5-wei-suo.why: The doer goes between 为 and 所; 所 sits right before the verb.

h5-wei-suo.ch: 这个问题已经为大多数人所了解。
h5-wei-suo.en: Most people are now aware of this problem.
h5-wei-suo.why: 为 + doer (大多数人) + 所 + two-syllable verb.

h5-wei-suo.en: His suggestion was accepted by most people.
h5-wei-suo.why: 所 comes after the doer, right before the verb: 为大多数人所接受.

h5-wen.why: 闻 is the verb 'to smell'; 好闻 = nice to smell.

h5-wen.ch: 我不喜欢这种香水的闻。
h5-wen.fix: 我不喜欢这种香水的味道。
h5-wen.en: I don't like the smell of this perfume.
h5-wen.why: 闻 is only the verb; the smell itself is 味道.
闻到 + smell: the verb comes first, 味道 is the thing smelled.

h5-wen.ch: 这个菜看起来一般，闻起来却很香。
h5-wen.en: This dish doesn't look like much, but it smells great.
h5-wen.why: 闻起来 + adjective says how something smells.

h5-wen.en: The smell in the kitchen is awful.
h5-wen.why: 难闻 = bad to smell: 很难闻.

h5-wu.en: Please do not take photos inside the museum.
h5-wu.why: On signs and notices, 请勿 = please do not.

h5-wu.en: He isn't coming to class today.
h5-wu.why: 勿 only gives written orders on signs; plain 'not' is 不.

h5-wu.en: Please do not bring drinks into the classroom.
h5-wu.why: 请勿 comes first, then the action you mustn't do.

h5-wu.ch: 房间里有人休息，请勿打扰。
h5-wu.en: Someone is resting in this room - please do not disturb.
h5-wu.why: 请勿 + verb phrase: a firm, polite written 'don't'.

h5-wu.en: Caution, slippery floor - please do not run here.
h5-wu.why: 勿 comes right after 请: 请勿 + action.

h5-wuyi.ch: 对不起，我刚才是__的，请原谅我。
h5-wuyi.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to just now - please forgive me.
h5-wuyi.why: 是无意的 = I didn't do it on purpose.

h5-wuyi.en: Don't be angry - he didn't mean to step on you.
h5-wuyi.why: ……是无意的 says it wasn't on purpose.

h5-wuyi.ch: 他弄坏了你的手机，但是他是不故意的。
h5-wuyi.fix: 他弄坏了你的手机，但是他是无意的。
h5-wuyi.en: He broke your phone, but he didn't mean to.
h5-wuyi.why: 无意 already means 'not on purpose'; 是不故意的 is wrong.

h5-wuyi.ch: 我无意中听到他们在说我。
h5-wuyi.en: I happened to overhear them talking about me.
h5-wuyi.why: 无意中 + verb: it happened by chance.

h5-wuyi.en: The manager says the company has no plans to expand production for now.
h5-wuyi.why: Right before a verb, 无意 means 'have no intention of'.

h5-xia.ch: 你不懂就别__说，会让人误会的。
h5-xia.en: If you don't know, don't talk nonsense - people will get the wrong idea.
h5-xia.why: 瞎 + verb = doing it with nothing to go on.

h5-xia.ch: 你别想瞎了，他不会有问题的。
h5-xia.fix: 你别瞎想了，他不会有问题的。
h5-xia.en: Stop worrying over nothing - he'll be fine.
h5-xia.why: 瞎 works like an adverb, so it goes before the verb: 瞎想.

h5-xia.en: You don't know anything about it - don't just throw out ideas.
h5-xia.why: 别 + 瞎 + verb: don't do it blindly.
tpy: shén me dōu bù zhī dào

h5-xia.ch: 我不太会画画，刚才是瞎画的。
h5-xia.en: I can't really draw - I was just scribbling.
h5-xia.why: 瞎画 = drawing with no skill or plan.

h5-xia.en: You've never even been there - stop talking nonsense.
h5-xia.why: 瞎 goes right before the verb: 别瞎说了.

h5-xiangdang.ch: 这家饭店的菜__好吃，你一定要去试试。
h5-xiangdang.en: The food at this restaurant is really good - you must try it.
His Chinese is really rather good.
h5-xiangdang.why: 相当 already sets the degree - don't stack it with 极了.

h5-xiangdang.en: Her handwriting is really rather nice.
h5-xiangdang.why: It can follow 得: V 得 + 相当 + adjective.

h5-xiangdang.ch: 这台电脑的价格相当于我两个月的工资。
h5-xiangdang.en: This computer costs as much as two months of my pay.
h5-xiangdang.why: A 相当于 B = A is equal to B.

h5-xiangdang.en: This trip cost quite a lot of money.
h5-xiangdang.why: 相当 goes before the adjective: 相当多.

h5-xingdong.ch: 周末学校组织了一次爬山__。
h5-xingdong.en: At the weekend the school organised a hiking trip.
h5-xingdong.why: An organised event is 活动; 行动 means taking action.

h5-xingdong.en: Just having a plan is no use - what matters is acting on it.
h5-xingdong.why: 行动 is the doing that follows the talk.

h5-xingdong.ch: 奶奶年纪大了，行动很慢。
h5-xingdong.en: Grandma is getting old and moves slowly.
h5-xingdong.why: As a noun, 行动 can mean getting around.

h5-xingdong.ch: 这次行动很有意思，同学们都玩得很开心。
h5-xingdong.fix: 这次活动很有意思，同学们都玩得很开心。
h5-xingdong.en: This outing was great fun - everyone had a good time.
h5-xingdong.why: A fun event is 活动, not 行动.

h5-xingdong.en: After a whole afternoon of discussion, we decided to act at once.
h5-xingdong.why: 马上 + 行动: act right away.
ppy: tǎo lùn le yí ge xià wǔ

h5-xingkui.ch: __我带了伞，不然回家的路上就麻烦了。
h5-xingkui.en: Good thing I brought an umbrella, or getting home would have been a pain.
h5-xingkui.why: 幸亏 + lucky fact, 不然 + what would have gone wrong.

h5-xingkui.ch: 幸亏你告诉我，我不知道今天开会。
h5-xingkui.fix: 幸亏你告诉我，不然我还不知道今天开会。
h5-xingkui.en: Good thing you told me, or I wouldn't have known about today's meeting.
h5-xingkui.why: The second half should say what would have gone wrong, with 不然 / 要不 / 否则.

h5-xingkui.en: Luckily the doctor got there quickly, so he's out of danger.
h5-xingkui.why: 幸亏 + lucky fact, then 才没有 + what you escaped.

h5-xingkui.ch: 幸亏出门的时候看了一下天气预报，要不就穿少了。
h5-xingkui.en: Luckily I checked the forecast before going out, or I'd have dressed too lightly.
h5-xingkui.why: 幸亏 …，要不 + bad result: relief at a lucky escape.

h5-xingkui.en: I don't know the way - lucky you brought me, or I'd never have found it.
h5-xingkui.why: 幸亏 opens the lucky fact: 幸亏有你带我来.
ppy: bù rán kěn dìng zhǎo bú dào

h5-yaobu.ch: 快点儿吃吧，__菜就不好吃了。
h5-yaobu.en: Eat up, or the food won't be nice any more.
h5-yaobu.why: After an instruction, 要不 gives the consequence: otherwise.

h5-yaobu.ch: 要不你有空，就来我家玩儿。
h5-yaobu.fix: 要是你有空，就来我家玩儿。
h5-yaobu.en: If you're free, come round to my place.
h5-yaobu.why: 要不 means 'otherwise / how about', not 'if' - that's 要是.

h5-yaobu.en: Let's set off now, or we'll miss the plane.
h5-yaobu.why: Do A，要不 + what goes wrong if you don't.
tpy: gǎn bú shàng fēi jī le

h5-yaobu.ch: 这里太吵了，要不我们换个地方聊天吧？
h5-yaobu.en: It's too noisy here - how about we go somewhere else to chat?
h5-yaobu.why: At the start of a suggestion, 要不 means 'how about…?'.

h5-yaobu.en: Go to bed now, or you won't be able to get up tomorrow again.
h5-yaobu.why: 要不 opens the bad result after the advice.

h5-yidan.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.
h5-yidan.why: For an everyday 'as soon as', use 一……就; 一旦 is for a change that matters.

h5-yidan.en: Once trust is lost, it's very hard to get back.
h5-yidan.why: 一旦 + turning point，就 + lasting result.

h5-yidan.ch: 这个秘密一旦说出去，就收不回来了。
h5-yidan.en: Once this secret is out, there's no taking it back.
h5-yidan.why: 一旦……就: once it happens, it can't easily be undone.

h5-yidan.ch: 我一旦下课就去图书馆。
h5-yidan.en: I go to the library as soon as class finishes.
h5-yidan.why: A routine 'as soon as' is 一……就, not 一旦.

h5-yidan.en: Once people get used to an easy life, it's hard for them to rough it.
h5-yidan.why: 一旦 goes right before the event: 人一旦习惯了.

h5-yiji.ch: 请写上你的名字、手机号码__地址。
h5-yiji.en: Please write your name, mobile number and address.
h5-yiji.why: 以及 joins the last item of a formal list.

h5-yiji.ch: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，以及价格也不贵。
h5-yiji.fix: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，而且价格也不贵。
h5-yiji.en: The food at this restaurant is tasty, and it isn't expensive either.
h5-yiji.why: 以及 joins items in a list, not a new clause. To add another point, use 而且.

h5-yiji.en: The visitors this time included students, teachers and their parents.
h5-yiji.why: A、B + 以及 + C: 以及 comes before the last item.
tpy: zhè cì lái cān guān de

h5-yiji.ch: 我们要考虑时间、价格以及交通等问题。
h5-yiji.en: We need to think about time, price, transport and so on.
h5-yiji.why: 以及 links the last item of a formal list.

h5-yiji.en: He lost his wallet, his phone and all his ID.
h5-yiji.why: 以及 goes before the last item of the list.

h5-yilai.ch: 自从参加工作__，我很少回家。
h5-yilai.en: Since I started working, I've rarely been home.
h5-yilai.why: (自从) + event + 以来 covers the time from then until now.

h5-yilai.ch: 下个星期以来，我要每天锻炼。
h5-yilai.fix: 从下个星期开始，我要每天锻炼。
h5-yilai.en: From next week on, I'm going to exercise every day.
h5-yilai.why: 以来 runs from the past up to now, so it can't start in the future.

h5-yilai.en: Over the past six months he's lost ten kilos.
h5-yilai.why: Length of time + 以来: from then up to now.

h5-yilai.ch: 搬家以来，我已经认识了很多新邻居。
h5-yilai.en: Since moving house, I've met lots of new neighbours.
h5-yilai.why: Event + 以来 looks back from today.

h5-yilai.en: We haven't been in touch since we graduated.
h5-yilai.why: 以来 closes the event: 自从毕业以来.

h5-ying.ch: 我说不用了，他__要请我喝咖啡。
h5-ying.en: I said there was no need, but he insisted on buying me a coffee.
h5-ying.why: 硬 + 要 + verb: pushing it through against someone's wishes.

h5-ying.ch: 我不想喝，他硬我喝了一点儿。
h5-ying.fix: 我不想喝，他硬让我喝了一点儿。
h5-ying.en: I didn't want to drink, but he made me have some.
h5-ying.why: This 硬 is an adverb, so it needs a verb after it: 硬让.

h5-ying.en: The child didn't want to take his medicine, but his mum made him.
h5-ying.why: 硬 + 让 + person + verb: forcing the matter.

h5-ying.ch: 这个面包放了三天，已经硬了。
h5-ying.en: This bread has been sitting for three days - it's gone hard.
h5-ying.why: As an adjective, 硬 simply means hard.

h5-ying.en: The doctor said he should rest, but he insisted on going to work.
h5-ying.why: 硬 goes right before 要: 硬要 + verb.

h5-yiwu.ch: 他在图书馆__工作，一分钱也不拿。
h5-yiwu.en: He works at the library for free - he doesn't take a penny.
h5-yiwu.why: Before a verb, 义务 means doing it unpaid.

h5-yiwu.ch: 我妈妈每个星期六都义务给孩子们上课。
h5-yiwu.en: Every Saturday my mum teaches children for free.
h5-yiwu.why: 义务 + verb = volunteer, without pay.

h5-yiwu.en: Every one of us has a duty to protect the environment.
h5-yiwu.why: 有义务 + verb = have a duty to.

h5-yiwu.ch: 这件事情没有做好，都是我的义务。
h5-yiwu.fix: 这件事情没有做好，都是我的责任。
h5-yiwu.en: This wasn't done properly - it's all my fault.
h5-yiwu.why: Blame for something that went wrong is 责任; 义务 is a duty you owe.

h5-yiwu.en: Adults have a duty to tell children what's right.
h5-yiwu.why: 义务 comes right after 有: 有义务 + verb.

h5-yizhi.ch: 我的手表跟你的__，你也是在那个商店买的吗？
h5-yizhi.en: My watch is the same as yours - did you buy it in that shop too?
h5-yizhi.why: Two things looking the same is 一样; 一致 is for views and actions agreeing.

h5-yizhi.ch: 经过讨论，大家一致决定下个星期去旅行。
h5-yizhi.en: After talking it over, everyone agreed to go travelling next week.
h5-yizhi.why: 一致 + 决定 = decide unanimously.

h5-yizhi.en: Everyone in the class agreed he should be class monitor.
h5-yizhi.why: 一致 goes before the verb: 一致同意.

h5-yizhi.ch: 我们俩的生日一致，都是五月八号。
h5-yizhi.fix: 我们俩的生日一样，都是五月八号。
h5-yizhi.en: The two of us share a birthday - the 8th of May.
h5-yizhi.why: Two dates being the same is 一样; 一致 is for views lining up.

h5-yizhi.en: At the meeting everyone agreed this plan was the best.
h5-yizhi.why: 一致 goes before the verb: 一致认为.

h5-youli.en: Eating more fruit is good for your health.
h5-youli.why: 有利于 + thing = is good for.

h5-youli.fix: 这个新规定对我们有利。
h5-youli.en: This new rule works in our favour.
h5-youli.why: 有利 takes no object - use 对……有利 or 有利于.

h5-youli.en: Reading more is good for children's development.
h5-youli.why: A + 有利于 + B: B is what benefits.

h5-youli.ch: 现在的天气对农民很有利。
h5-youli.en: The weather at the moment is good for farmers.
h5-youli.why: 对 + who benefits + 很有利.

h5-youli.en: This location is great for doing business.
h5-youli.why: 对……很有利: 有利 comes at the end.

h5-yu.ch: 今年的学生人数多__去年。
h5-yu.en: There are more students this year than last year.
h5-yu.why: Adjective + 于 + B = more than B (written).

h5-yu.ch: 这个博物馆位于在北京。
h5-yu.why: 位于 already contains 'at', so don't add 在.
Verb + 于 + time: 成立于 = was founded in.

h5-yu.ch: 这件衣服的价格高于那件。
h5-yu.en: This piece of clothing costs more than that one.
h5-yu.why: 高于 = higher than, the written 比.

h5-yu.en: My home town is in the south of China.

h5-yuqi-buru.ch: 与其在这里等公共汽车，__走回去。
h5-yuqi-buru.en: Rather than waiting here for the bus, we might as well walk back.
h5-yuqi-buru.why: 与其 pairs with 不如 - the better choice goes after 不如.

h5-yuqi-buru.ch: 宁可在家看电视，不如出去运动运动。
h5-yuqi-buru.fix: 与其在家看电视，不如出去运动运动。
h5-yuqi-buru.en: Rather than watching TV at home, go out and get some exercise.
h5-yuqi-buru.why: 不如 pairs with 与其, not 宁可.

h5-yuqi-buru.en: Rather than spend money on a new one, fix the old one.
h5-yuqi-buru.why: 与其 + rejected choice，不如 + better choice.

h5-yuqi-buru.ch: 与其每天抱怨，不如想想怎么改变。
h5-yuqi-buru.en: Instead of complaining every day, think about how to change things.
h5-yuqi-buru.why: 与其 A 不如 B: B is the better choice.

h5-yuqi-buru.en: The exam's tomorrow - better to study than play games.
h5-yuqi-buru.why: 与其 goes before the choice you turn down.

h5-zaisan.ch: 老师__提醒我们，考试的时候一定要写上名字。
h5-zaisan.en: The teacher kept reminding us to write our names on the exam.
h5-zaisan.why: 再三 + verb: someone deliberately says it again and again.

h5-zaisan.ch: 今天再三下雨，衣服都干不了。
h5-zaisan.fix: 今天一直下雨，衣服都干不了。
h5-zaisan.en: It's been raining all day - the washing won't dry.
h5-zaisan.why: 再三 is for things people choose to repeat, not for weather.

h5-zaisan.en: After we'd invited him again and again, he finally said yes.
h5-zaisan.why: 再三 goes before the action that was repeated: 再三邀请.

h5-zaisan.ch: 医生再三提醒他要按时吃药。
h5-zaisan.en: The doctor reminded him again and again to take his medicine on time.
h5-zaisan.why: 再三提醒: reminding someone over and over, earnestly.

h5-zaisan.en: Mum told me again and again to be careful on the way.
h5-zaisan.why: 再三 goes right before the verb: 再三告诉.

h5-ze.ch: 哥哥喜欢安静，弟弟__喜欢热闹。
h5-ze.en: The older brother likes peace and quiet, whereas the younger one likes a bit of noise.
h5-ze.why: In a contrast, 则 comes right after the second subject.

h5-ze.ch: 我爱吃辣的，则我女朋友一点儿辣的也不吃。
h5-ze.fix: 我爱吃辣的，我女朋友则一点儿辣的也不吃。
h5-ze.en: I love spicy food, whereas my girlfriend won't touch it.
h5-ze.why: Like 却, 则 goes after the second subject, not at the start of the clause.

h5-ze.en: From here to the airport takes half an hour at least, an hour at most.
h5-ze.why: 少则 X，多则 Y gives a range: at least X, at most Y.

h5-ze.ch: 城市里的年轻人越来越多，农村则越来越安静。
h5-ze.en: More and more young people live in cities, while the countryside gets quieter and quieter.
h5-ze.why: Second subject 农村 + 则: a calm contrast.

h5-ze.en: Some people like to exercise in the morning, while others prefer the evening.
h5-ze.why: 则 goes right after the second subject: 有的人则…….

h5-zhaochang.ch: 明天虽然是国庆节，但是银行__营业。
h5-zhaochang.en: Tomorrow is National Day, but the banks will open as usual.
h5-zhaochang.why: 照常 = carrying on as normal even though something might have stopped it.

h5-zhaochang.ch: 我照常晚上十一点睡觉。
h5-zhaochang.fix: 我平时晚上十一点睡觉。
h5-zhaochang.en: I usually go to bed at eleven.
h5-zhaochang.why: For a plain habit use 平时; 照常 means carrying on despite something.

h5-zhaochang.en: Despite the heavy snow, the match went ahead as usual.
tpy: suī rán xià zhe dà xuě

h5-zhaochang.ch: 老板出差了，公司里一切照常。
h5-zhaochang.en: The boss is away on business, but everything at the company is running as normal.
h5-zhaochang.why: 一切照常 = everything as normal.

h5-zhaochang.en: He had a fever yesterday, but he still came to work as usual today.
h5-zhaochang.why: 照常 goes right before the verb: 还是照常来上班.

h5-zhi.ch: 桌子上有三__铅笔，你随便用。
h5-zhi.en: There are three pencils on the table - help yourself.
h5-zhi.why: Long, thin things like pencils take 支.
Books take 本; 支 is for long, thin things like pens.

h5-zhi.en: There's only one tube of toothpaste left at home.
h5-zhi.why: Number + 支 + noun: 一支牙膏.

h5-zhi.en: This pencil is my younger sister's.
h5-zhi.why: 这 + 支 + 铅笔: pencils take 支.
支 goes right after the number: 一支漂亮的花.

h5-zhi-2.en: I've lived in Beijing ever since I was little.
h5-zhi-2.why: For 'all along' use 一直; 直 + verb is a nonstop reaction right now.

h5-zhi-2.en: The child is so hungry he can't stop crying.
h5-zhi-2.why: Adjective + 得 + 直 + verb: a reaction you can't stop.

h5-zhi-2.en: Go straight on from this junction for a hundred metres and you're there.

h5-zhi-2.ch: 他直在这家公司工作，已经十年了。
h5-zhi-2.fix: 他一直在这家公司工作，已经十年了。
h5-zhi-2.en: He's been working at this company all along - ten years now.
h5-zhi-2.why: 'All along' needs 一直; 直 alone doesn't mean that.

h5-zhi-2.en: This dish is so spicy he keeps gulping water.
h5-zhi-2.why: 直 comes after 得 and before the verb: 辣得直喝水.

h5-zhijin.ch: 这件事情过去二十年了，我__还记得很清楚。
h5-zhijin.en: That was twenty years ago, and I still remember it clearly.
h5-zhijin.why: 至今 = up to now, still; it often comes with 还.

h5-zhijin.ch: 我至今很饿，我们去吃点儿东西吧。
h5-zhijin.fix: 我现在很饿，我们去吃点儿东西吧。
h5-zhijin.en: I'm hungry now - let's go and get something to eat.
h5-zhijin.why: 至今 means 'still, after all this time', not just 'now'.

h5-zhijin.en: He borrowed my book and still hasn't given it back.
h5-zhijin.why: 至今 + 还没有 + verb: it still hasn't happened.
tpy: tā jiè le wǒ de shū

h5-zhijin.ch: 这座桥一百多年了，至今还在用。
h5-zhijin.en: This bridge is over a hundred years old and is still in use today.
h5-zhijin.why: 至今 + 还: still true after all this time.

h5-zhijin.en: We've discussed this problem many times and still have no answer.
h5-zhijin.why: 至今 goes before 还没有: 至今还没有结果.

h5-zhiyu.ch: 只是一次小考试，你__紧张得吃不下东西吧？
h5-zhiyu.en: It's only a little test - surely you're not so nervous you can't eat?
h5-zhiyu.why: 不至于 = it's not so bad that…

h5-zhiyu.ch: 你先把工作做好，至于工资，到时候再谈。
h5-zhiyu.en: Do the work well first; as for pay, we'll talk about that when the time comes.
h5-zhiyu.why: 至于 turns to the next point, often one you're putting off.

h5-zhiyu.en: We're going travelling; as for where, we haven't decided yet.
h5-zhiyu.why: 至于 opens a new clause that switches to a related point.
tpy: wǒ men yào qù lǚ xíng

h5-zhiyu.ch: 我买了一本至于电脑的书。
h5-zhiyu.fix: 我买了一本关于电脑的书。
h5-zhiyu.en: I bought a book about computers.
h5-zhiyu.why: 'About' a topic is 关于; 至于 only turns to the next point.

h5-zhiyu.en: I know he's married; as for who his wife is, I've no idea.
h5-zhiyu.why: 至于 starts the clause that moves to the next point.

h5-zhubu.ch: 学校打算__增加学生的运动时间。
h5-zhubu.en: The school plans to increase students' exercise time step by step.
h5-zhubu.why: 逐步 + verb: a planned change carried out in stages.

h5-zhubu.ch: 这几年，他的头发逐步白了。
h5-zhubu.fix: 这几年，他的头发逐渐白了。
h5-zhubu.en: His hair has slowly gone grey over the last few years.
h5-zhubu.why: Hair greys on its own, so it's 逐渐; 逐步 is for steps people plan.

h5-zhubu.en: The company plans to raise staff pay step by step.
h5-zhubu.why: 逐步 goes right before the planned action: 逐步提高.

h5-zhubu.ch: 我们打算逐步把办公室里的旧电脑换掉。
h5-zhubu.en: We plan to replace the old computers in the office bit by bit.
h5-zhubu.why: 逐步 fits a change people plan and carry out in stages.

h5-zhubu.en: The doctor advised him to build up his daily running time step by step.
h5-zhubu.why: 逐步 goes right before the verb: 逐步增加.

h5-zhujian.en: As evening came, the sky slowly grew dark.
h5-zhujian.why: Night falling happens by itself, so it's 逐渐, not the planned 逐步.

h5-zhujian.fix: 他的汉语水平逐渐提高了。
h5-zhujian.why: 逐渐 describes a change, so the verb needs 了, 起来 or 变.

h5-zhujian.en: After living here a year, I've gradually come to love this city.
h5-zhujian.why: 逐渐 goes before the verb of change: 逐渐喜欢上了.

h5-zhujian.ch: 吃了几天药，他的身体逐渐好了。
h5-zhujian.en: After a few days of medicine, he's slowly getting better.
h5-zhujian.why: 逐渐 + change + 了: little by little, by itself.

h5-zhujian.en: The snow has stopped and the sky is gradually getting brighter.
h5-zhujian.why: 逐渐 goes right before the change: 逐渐亮了.

h5-zicong.en: Starting today, I'm giving up coffee.
h5-zicong.why: 自从 only looks back to a past event; for today or the future use 从.

h5-zicong.ch: 自从买了新电脑，我工作快多了。
h5-zicong.en: Since buying a new computer, I've been working much faster.
h5-zicong.why: 自从 + past event: things have been different since then.

h5-zicong.en: Ever since I got a phone, I've hardly watched TV.
h5-zicong.why: 自从 + past event, then what has been true since.

h5-zicong.ch: 自从下个月，我要去中国留学。
h5-zicong.fix: 从下个月起，我要去中国留学。
h5-zicong.en: From next month, I'm going to study in China.
h5-zicong.why: 自从 can't point to the future; use 从……起.

h5-zicong.en: Ever since I started running, I've been getting healthier and healthier.
h5-zicong.why: 自从 goes before the past event: 我自从开始跑步.

h5-zongsuan.ch: 找了三天，我__找到了丢的钥匙。
h5-zongsuan.en: After three days of looking, I finally found the keys I'd lost.
h5-zongsuan.why: 总算 = at last, with a sigh of relief after a long wait or effort.

h5-zongsuan.ch: 天天吃很多甜的，他总算胖了十公斤。
h5-zongsuan.fix: 天天吃很多甜的，他终于胖了十公斤。
h5-zongsuan.en: He ate lots of sweet things every day, and in the end he put on ten kilos.
h5-zongsuan.why: 总算 carries relief, so it only fits outcomes you wanted; for a bad result use 终于.

h5-zongsuan.en: Thanks to everyone's hard work, this problem has finally been solved.
h5-zongsuan.why: Effort first, then subject + 总算 + verb + 了.
tpy: jīng guò dà jiā de nǔ lì

h5-zongsuan.ch: 这次比赛虽然没有得冠军，不过总算得了第二。
h5-zongsuan.en: I didn't win the competition this time, but at least I came second.
h5-zongsuan.why: 总算 can also mean 'at least' when things could have been worse.

h5-zongsuan.en: After a month of rushing around, I can finally take a few days off.
h5-zongsuan.why: 总算 goes after the subject, before the verb: 我总算可以…….

h5-zongzhi.ch: 这里交通方便，环境也好，__我很喜欢这个地方。
h5-zongzhi.en: The transport's convenient and the surroundings are nice - in short, I really like it here.
h5-zongzhi.why: After the reasons, 总之 gives the conclusion.

h5-zongzhi.ch: 总之，请大家看一下第一页。
h5-zongzhi.fix: 首先，请大家看一下第一页。
h5-zongzhi.en: First, please everyone look at page one.
h5-zongzhi.why: 总之 sums up what came before, so it can't open a talk - use 首先.

h5-zongzhi.en: This top is cheap and it looks good - all in all, I'm very happy with it.
h5-zongzhi.why: Reasons first, then 总之 + the bottom line.

h5-zongzhi.ch: 你坐飞机也好，坐公共汽车也好，总之明天一定要到。
h5-zongzhi.en: Fly or take the coach - either way, you must be there tomorrow.
h5-zongzhi.why: 总之 cuts through the options to the point that matters.

h5-zongzhi.en: The pay's low, it's far from home, the colleagues aren't friendly - basically, I don't want to do it any more.
h5-zongzhi.why: 总之 comes after the list of reasons, before the conclusion.

h5-zuowei.en: As a doctor, he's busy every day.
h5-zuowei.why: 作为 + role names the role that explains what follows.

h5-zuowei.ch: 作为他是班长，他应该帮助同学。
h5-zuowei.fix: 作为班长，他应该帮助同学。
h5-zuowei.en: As class monitor, he should help his classmates.
h5-zuowei.why: The role comes straight after 作为 - no 他是.

h5-zuowei.en: The school uses this room as an office.
h5-zuowei.why: 把 A 作为 B: use A as B.

h5-zuowei.ch: 作为学生，最重要的是学习。
h5-zuowei.en: As a student, the most important thing is to study.
h5-zuowei.why: 作为 + role at the start of the sentence: 'as a …'.

h5-zuowei.en: As his friends, we should respect his choice.
h5-zuowei.why: 作为 + role comes straight after the subject: 我们作为朋友.
